Fixed-point algebra produces both hyperbolic amplitude laws, strictly monotone sinh z/z proves the sharp λ=1/2 crossover, hyperbolic addition yields the exponential-ratio identity and its power-independent growth exponent. value.rationale: The result addresses long-time stationary-pattern fidelity of two ubiquitous symmetric subflow orders. A structural graph eigenmode reduction yields an exact all-graph, all-odd-degree phase diagram rather than a random isolated example: one order always undershoots, the other has a sharp sign transition and an exactly stationary branch at λ=1/2 for every step, while fixed-point multipliers agree yet physical amplitudes diverge exponentially with a power-independent exponent. It gives a motivated benchmark beyond usual finite-time consistency and the known generic fact of splitting steady-state bias.
